item.title: High school boys basketball: Red Hook’s quest for first Section 9 title in a decade comes up short
item.description: When Red Hook High senior guard Mathew Simmons walked off the court for the final time late in the fourth quarter in a 62-37 loss to Beacon in the Section 9 Class A boys basketball championship game on Friday, March 6, he pulled his jersey top over his face and embraced head coach Kevin Cayea on the sidelines at Mount Saint Mary College.

item.title: High school boys basketball: Blistering start earns Kingston a Section 9 Class AAA championship
item.description: When James Naismith invented the game of basketball in 1891, it's unlikely he thought any team could make it look as easy as Kingston High's boys basketball team did in the first half of the Section 9 Class AAA championship game at Monroe-Woodbury High on Saturday, March 7.

item.title: What’s happening in the Mid-Hudson Valley: March 8, 2026
item.description: "Spot On": An art exhibition, titled "Spot On, aka, See Spot Run," is currently on display at 68 Prince Street Gallery, 68 Prince St., Kingston. The exhibition features art by Sharon Butler. Jason Travers, Murray Hochman, and Eileen Power. It will open with a reception from 5 to 8 p.m. The exhibition will remain on display through Sunday, March 8. For more information, visit 68princestgallery.com.
